exposure: Infants' absence of ARV prophylaxis at birth
Maternal non-disclosure of HIV status to partner/families
outcome: Incidence of mother-to-child transmission of HIV
cohort: The study included records of 469 HIV-exposed infant-mother pairs from public hospitals in South Gondar, Northwest Ethiopia.
finding: The cumulative incidence rate of mother-to-child transmission of HIV was 5.2 per 1000 person-months, and predictors of HIV positivity included infants' absence of ARV prophylaxis at birth, mothers without PMTCT intervention, home delivery, and mothers who were not disclosing their HIV status to families.
mod_finding: Home delivery was identified as a predictor of HIV positivity among exposed infants.
